title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Investments
description: The aim of this is to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the principles and practices of investment management.
longDescription: Analyse Investment options. Understand the difference between Real and Financial Assets and the concept of Return and Risk. Understand and apply the principles of Asset Allocation, Portfolio Management. Appraise different Investment Models. Manage Risk in investments. The course "Understanding Investments" aims to provide students with an overview of investment fundamentals and concepts, enabling them to understand various investment options, evaluate investment risks, and develop investment strategies. courseDetails: The course "Understanding Investments" is designed to introduce students to the world of investing. The course covers various topics like investment analysis, portfolio management, and risk assessment. Students will learn to evaluate investment options, understand financial markets, and develop investment strategies. The course will equip students with the knowledge and skills to make informed investment decisions.
